content.value: What are the objectives of Linear Prograrming? Suppose, A specialist steel (20) manufacturer produces two types of steel g1 and g2. Type 1 requires 2 hours of melting, 4 hours of rolling, and 10 hours of cutting. Type 2 requires 5 hours of melting, 1 hour of rolling, and 5 hours of cutting. Forty hours are available for melting, 20 for rolling, and 60 for cutting. The profit margin for type 1 is 24; For type 2 it is 8. Reduce the data to the equations and inequalities necessary to determine the output mix that will maximize profit.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
